open KdVPlan in
 (∀ s a c b : ℝ, a≤c → c≤b → ∀ f : Path,
   ContH s a c f → ContH s c b f → ContH s a b f) ∧
 (∀ a b : ℝ, ∀ f g : Path, SmoothOn a b f →
   (∀ t ∈ Icc a b, g t=f t) → SmoothOn a b g)
proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  constructor
  · intro s a c b hac hcb f hf hg
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      by_cases htc : t≤c
      · exact hf.1 t ⟨ht.1,htc⟩
      · exact hg.1 t ⟨le_of_not_ge htc,ht.2⟩
    · intro t ht ε hε
      rcases lt_trichotomy t c with htc|htc|htc
      · obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hf.2 t ⟨ht.1,htc.le⟩ ε hε
        refine ⟨min δ (c-t),lt_min hδ (sub_pos.mpr htc),?_⟩
        intro r hr hdr
        have hh: r<c:=by
          have := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))).2
          linarith
        exact hd r ⟨hr.1,hh.le⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
      · subst t
        obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hf.2 c ⟨hac,le_rfl⟩ ε hε
        obtain ⟨η,hη,he⟩:=hg.2 c ⟨le_rfl,hcb⟩ ε hε
        refine ⟨min δ η,lt_min hδ hη,?_⟩
        intro r hr hdr
        by_cases hrc : r≤c
        · exact hd r ⟨hr.1,hrc⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
        · exact he r ⟨le_of_not_ge hrc,hr.2⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))
      · obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hg.2 t ⟨htc.le,ht.2⟩ ε hε
        refine ⟨min δ (t-c),lt_min hδ (sub_pos.mpr htc),?_⟩
        intro r hr hdr
        have hh : c<r:=by
          have := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))).1
          linarith
        exact hd r ⟨hh.le,hr.2⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
  · intro a b f g hf he
    refine ⟨fun k=>(hf.1 k).congr (fun t ht=>congrFun (he t ht) k),?_⟩
    intro m j
    apply @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ _ (hf.2 m j)
    intro t ht
    funext k
    exact iteratedDerivWithin_congr (fun r hr=>congrFun (he r hr) k) ht)
